The best dinner buffet in Ho Chi Minh City
Oct 2025 • Couples
My wife and I had the MOST EXCELLENT dinner this evening at this restaurant in Pullman Saigon Centre - Food Connexion - and it was a Vietnamese and Western seafood-centric dinner buffet. When we walked into the restaurant, we were very impressed by the various food stations' display - they looked positively inviting and yummy (see the photos herein). Everything seemed and was fresh - freshly prepared and perfectly prepared. And the service here was simply OUTSTANDING - especially from the following ladies: Xuan, Vi, Tram and Anh, who very friendly, courteous, attentive and helpful. The dining ambience here was also very, very good. The dining spaces were ample and super comfortable. And apart from the buffet selections, the ala carte selections that came with the dinner buffet package were fantastic - my wife and I especially love the Lobster Thermidor. However, this dinner buffet is (according to the restaurant) available only from Friday to Sunday. So, if you are looking for a MOST EXCELLENT dinner buffet, I highly recommend Food Connexion at Pullman Saigon Centre.
